pages.text: From the $(l)Outbreak$() on, nests sicken the land around them. Grass turns to $(l)blighted soil$(), where nothing can be planted and the spores can make you ill. Leaves wither, small plants die, and crops are knocked back to seedlings.$(br2)Nothing else is ever touched, and nothing is lost for good.
With no nest left nearby, blighted soil and withered leaves slowly recover on their own: grass returns, and each tree its own kind of leaf. Kill the nest and the land heals.
